text: Ontario Regulation 286/09 "Budget Matters - Expenses" (Regulation) permits the City of Toronto (City) to exclude the following expenses from its annual budget: - amortization expenses; - post-employment benefits expenses; and - solid waste landfill closure and post-closure expenses. In addition, the Regulation requires that the City: - Prepare a report about the excluded expenses which contains: - An estimate of the change in accumulated surplus as a result of the exclusion of the above expenses. - An analysis of the estimated impact of the exclusion of these expenses on future tangible capital asset funding requirements. - Adopt the report prior to the adoption of its annual budget. This report is presented to Committee and Council in response to the Regulation.
